shared_elements: animal-and-human pairing (possible leading of an animal)
justification: Both surfaces appear to show a profile quadruped accompanied by a human figure, but in A these are barely legible, stick-like schematic scratchings with no discernible attributes, while B is a fully naturalistic, modelled relief of a two-humped camel with a bridle led by a costumed attendant with staff, framed by rosette borders. The only correspondence is the generic pairing of animal and human in profile, which any tradition could produce independently; the rendering conventions, proportions and the ornamental register bands share nothing.
